description: Straßennetzkarte - Stadt Werder (Havel) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal-werder-havel.de. The road network map provides information on roads, network nodes and sections of the road network. The higher-level road network (federal, state and district roads) is based on information provided by the © Landesbetrieb für Straßenwesen Brandenburg). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Street map - City of Werder (Havel)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, land use, Straßen, Werder (Havel). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
